# qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase; the licence is in the file's header)

Used only by JET's Gmail set-up page (`/jet/#/gmail`, docs/trips.md §17.1) to show the phone link as
a QR code. Stored here, not loaded from a CDN, so the pages' policy stays `script-src 'self'`; loaded
with `import()` only when that page shows the link. No `eval`, no network.

Byte-identical to the npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4` (`dist/`):

    qrcode.mjs  sha256 ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0
